import std.io

pub type AppError = Failed(String)

fn sum(a: Int16, b: Int16) -> Int16 {
    return a + b
}

pub fn main() effect io -> Result<(), AppError> {
    var a: Int8 = 100i8
    let b: Int8 = a + 20i8
    var lo: Int8 = -128i8
    let hi: Int8 = lo + 127i8
    var u: UInt8 = 200u8
    let c: UInt8 = ~u
    var q: UInt16 = 60000u16
    let d: UInt16 = q / 3u16
    var r: Int8 = -128i8
    let e: Int8 = r % -1i8
    let f: Int16 = sum(300i16, 40i16)
    var big: UInt32 = 4294967295u32
    let g: UInt32 = big * 1u32
    io.println("${b} ${hi} ${c} ${d} ${e} ${f} ${g}")
    return Ok(())
}
